Full replication of the simulation suite from
@Koller2024 (Nature Communications, 2024,
[doi:10.1038/s41467-024-47860-x](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-47860-x)).

The study is encoded in [`Koller2024.yaml`](Koller2024.yaml) as a single
`SimulationStudy` containing 14 experiments (Figures 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 plus
supplementary controls). Two model classes are exercised: Kuramoto phase
oscillators on a 2D abstract sheet (Exp 01-06) and Kuramoto / Jansen-Rit
neural masses on the Schaefer-1000 HCP cortical connectome (Exp 30-51).

```{python}
from tvbo import SimulationStudy
import bsplot
import importlib
import Koller2024_plot as kplot

bsplot.style.use("tvbo")

odir = "./figures"
study = SimulationStudy.from_file("Koller2024.yaml")
```

## Experiment 01 + 02 — 2D sheet: gradient vs uniform (Fig. 2)

```{python}
res_grad = study.get_experiment(1).run("tvboptim")
res_unif = study.get_experiment(2).run("tvboptim")
fig2 = kplot.plot_fig2(res_grad, res_unif)
# fig2.savefig(f"{odir}/Koller2024_Fig2.png", dpi=300)
fig2
```

## Experiments 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 38, 39 — Cortical SC variants (Fig. 5)

```{python}
res5 = {
    "main":        study.get_experiment(30).run("tvb"),
    "shuffled":    study.get_experiment(31).run("tvb"),
    "distance":    study.get_experiment(32).run("tvb"),
    "jansenrit":   study.get_experiment(33).run("tvb"),
    "normalised":  study.get_experiment(34).run("tvb"),
    "no_delay":    study.get_experiment(38).run("tvb"),
    "const_delay": study.get_experiment(39).run("tvb"),
}
importlib.reload(kplot)
fig5 = kplot.plot_fig5(res5)
fig5.savefig(f"{odir}/Koller2024_Fig5.png", dpi=300)
fig5
```

## Experiment 40 — IF x K x v parameter sweep (Figs 6, 7, 8)

This is the most expensive experiment: 4 IF values x 39 K values x 10 v values
x 10 trials = 15 600 simulations. Run on a workstation with sufficient memory.

```{python}
res40 = study.get_experiment(40).run("tvb")
```

```{python}
importlib.reload(kplot)
fig6 = kplot.plot_fig6(res40)
fig6.savefig(f"{odir}/Koller2024_Fig6.png", dpi=300)
fig6
```

```{python}
importlib.reload(kplot)
fig7 = kplot.plot_fig7(res40)
fig7.savefig(f"{odir}/Koller2024_Fig7.png", dpi=300)
fig7
```

```{python}
import numpy as np
instrength = kplot._instrength(res40.results[0])
importlib.reload(kplot)
fig8 = kplot.plot_fig8(res40, instrength)
fig8.savefig(f"{odir}/Koller2024_Fig8.png", dpi=300)
fig8
```
